mt.title: Music lessons
mt.intro: Piano, guitar and bass: scales, chords, songs and jamming. The teacher shows what to play, plays it for you, then listens and tells you what was right. Each instrument has a course that remembers how far you have come.
mt.how.1: “music lesson”, to go on with your course
mt.how.2: “teach me piano”, to choose an instrument
mt.midi.none: No MIDI instrument: install ovos-phal-plugin-midi to hear the examples
mt.reset.sure: Start this course again from the first lesson?
mt.reset.done: The course starts from the first lesson again.
